requirements.title: `universal_skills` is served as a content-only connector

`pyproject.toml` declares `[project.entry-points."agent_connector_sdk.connector"]` with the single value `universal_skills` (bare package, content only), depends on `agent-connector-sdk[mcp]>=0.5.0,<0.6.0`, and declares no `agent_utilities.skill_providers` or other provider group. The SDK pytest plugin supplies the conformance checks, so the repository holds no copy of them. Proving test: `tests/test_catalog_content.py::test_declares_one_content_only_entry_point`

Every skill lives at `universal_skills/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, one level deep, and its frontmatter `name` equals its folder name. Supporting files stay inside the skill folder so they are served with it. Proving test: `tests/test_catalog_content.py::test_every_skill_is_flat_and_named_by_folder`
The server the SDK builds for `universal_skills` lists one `skill://<name>/SKILL.md` resource for every skill folder. Proving test: `tests/test_catalog_content.py::test_server_lists_every_skill`
